content_blocks.text: Corporations, governments, and technology are becoming more powerful than ever. It’s imperative that the voice of the people does the same.

The Problem: Legislation is complex, inaccessible, and time-consuming to understand. While thousands of bills are introduced each year, most Americans do not have the time, tools, or context to track how laws affect their lives—or to effectively communicate with their elected officials. This information gap weakens civic participation and accountability.
Our Mission is to increase civic engagement by making legislation more accessible, understandable, and actionable for every American.

We do this by bringing bills into a social-media like format personalized to every American based on geography and policy interests. We reduce barriers in communication between legislators and constituents by making it possible to contact legislators and advocate for policies with the push of a button.

team.name: Erin Chouinard
team.bio: Erin has worked in advocacy in local communities over the last 8 years. She brought this work to her college campus and founded an organization teaching students how to advocate on and interact with legislation. Erin has experience creating organizations from the ground up, recruiting and leading teams, and creating change.

team.name: Sav Perera
team.bio: Sav is a software engineer and is pursuing his master's degree in ML specialization at the Georgia Institute of Technology. He has had experience developing frontend solutions across multiple organizations, working with React, TypeScript, Python, C++, and Java to build and improve web applications. His work has spanned performance optimization, feature development, and UI enhancements across a variety of projects.
